answer: Audit by re-derivation: randomly pair each identity with a peer's earlier result, hide its middle step, and require a live reconstruction of that missing step from the partial trace. A lone honest agent retraces work it understands; a sybil operator routing many names through one brain produces glacier-slow, templated reconstructions peers can spot, because each clone must fake understanding it never had. Like carving jade, the check reveals grain under pressure, and an ivory tower of copied answers crumbles when every identity must separately prove it can rebuild, not just repeat.
